assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production Live2D separated EYE component texture sheet. Image 1 is the exact original character reference, not a style suggestion. Extract/reconstruct its eyes faithfully: original hand-painted textured linework, lavender grey irises, dark grey tops, square white catchlights, thin brown eyebrows and black lashes. Create ONE square 2048x2048 texture sheet with TWO COLUMNS (left column viewer-left eye; right column viewer-right eye) and FIVE ROWS. Each cell is a separate cutout with ample transparent padding, no overlaps, NO TEXT NO LABELS NO LINES. Row 1: ONLY the corresponding thin angled brown eyebrow. Row 2: ONLY the corresponding thick upper eyelash contour including fine outer lashes, curved exactly as in the reference open eye; NO eyeball/skin. Row 3: ONLY a fully reconstructed white sclera almond shape, subtle grey shadow at top, no pupil, no lashes, no skin. Row 4: ONLY a complete ROUND iris disk, reconstructed hidden upper edge, grey-lavender gradient and original exact square highlight, no sclera/lashes. Row 5: ONLY the thin lower eyelid contour of that eye, no skin/iris. Center each component within its own cell. Both eye assemblies should have exactly matching scales: use large 500-pixel-wide sclera with 380-pixel-diameter iris in the corresponding cells; upper lash spans 550 pixels. All parts derive from the original, do not modernize or change character identity. Actual transparent RGBA background, never draw checkerboard. No face, no hair, no body. The sheet is a separated rigging asset, not an assembled face.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production Live2D head-and-hair decomposition texture sheet. Image 1 is the exact original character to preserve. Make ONE 2048x2048 transparent texture sheet in a THREE COLUMN by TWO ROW layout, six separate isolated cutouts, ample padding and no overlap. No labels or divider lines. Consistent original orange-brown painted texture and exact hair silhouette. Cell row1 col1: ONLY skin face, ears and short neck, complete rounded forehead hidden under bangs reconstructed; preserve original nose and pointed jaw, remove eyes eyebrows mouth and ALL hair. Blank skin matched exactly to original cream skin and warm shadows, no skin holes. Cell row1 col2: ONLY back hair mass that sits behind face, crown and long straight back curtains, with inner hidden strands filled so head can turn, no face or foreground locks. Cell row1 col3: ONLY frontal bangs/crown fringe, exact original asymmetrical spiky tips, no face, no side locks. Cell row2 col1: ONLY long thin viewer-left foreground hair lock from temple down to its sharp tip beside collar. Cell row2 col2: ONLY original thick sweeping viewer-right foreground hair lock from temple down to the curled tip over chest. Cell row2 col3: ONLY small red tie including knot and lower tie, reconstructing top edge for animation. Preserve the original paint grain, colors, shapes, and character design; do not smooth or modernize. Complete each hidden attachment with modest overlap. Each part fits inside its cell without cropping. Actual transparent RGBA background, NOT a drawn checkerboard. No whole character, no additional objects, no eyes or mouth, no text.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: production Live2D mouth component texture sheet. Image 1 is the exact original face reference. Create one square 1024x1024 texture sheet with TWO COLUMNS and THREE ROWS, each containing one isolated mouth part, all at consistent scale equivalent to a 350 pixel wide mouth. Preserve original pale cream skin shading and thin muted brown hand-painted lip lines; no glossy lipstick, no anime style change. Upper-left: ONLY the upper lip contour of a gently open neutral mouth, including tiny skin highlight around it, a shallow curve whose corners point slightly down like original. Upper-right: ONLY matching lower lip contour and original short soft skin shadow, same width. Middle-left: ONLY the mouth interior, a dark warm brown maroon open oval, no lips, no skin, no teeth, no tongue. Middle-right: ONLY a subtle off-white thin upper teeth strip that fits inside the cavity, no lips or cavity background. Bottom-left: ONLY a small muted pink tongue shape. Bottom-right: ONLY a fine complete CLOSED neutral mouth line matching the original slight frown with small pale highlight, full width. Plenty of transparent spacing between six parts, no overlap, no assembled face, no labels, no text, no gridlines. Actual transparent RGBA background; never draw a checkerboard. This is a high fidelity rigging decomposition, not new character art.
